activity.notes: Conrad II of the Salian dynasty was crowned emperor in Rome on 26 March 1027 and remained Holy Roman Emperor until his death in 1039. ATLAS records the imperial office interval and reuses the existing Holy Roman Empire polity rather than conflating it with his earlier German and Italian kingships.
